annotation.evidence_span: settings that are not compatible with the previously specified settings
annotation.interpretation_a: Any change to a setting value that differs from the value previously sent by the client is considered incompatible, regardless of whether the change is allowed by the protocol.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only changes that violate protocol rules (e.g., setting a reserved identifier or a value outside the allowed range) are considered incompatible; otherwise, a different value is acceptable.
annotation.justification: The clause uses the undefined term "not compatible" without specifying what constitutes incompatibility, allowing at least two reasonable interpretations of the required behavior.
